note: Dundy County has a planning and zoning office, but no public ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning district layer was found. The county planning page links only to a contact form and an FAQ page; the county GIS site (dundy.gworks.com) is a parcel viewer with no queryable service. Benkelman, the county seat, publishes its zoning ordinance only as PDF text with no map service. ArcGIS searches for Dundy/Benkelman zoning returned nothing. The county website's planning page returned HTTP 503 (Wordfence rate limit) during checks.
